<!-- pr-reviewer: 5791f373fabab285e02aab55606c338abba21fbc -->
Needs changes before merge.

The selection test checks all four stated app entry points. The decision record and the process declaration are present.

I reviewed the PR against current upstream AGENTS.md. I trial-merged it locally with upstream/main at b4be144f6a5443958d4d6914996c5165fba6ae35. The merge had no conflicts. No GitHub runner was used.

Local results:
- Quick-gate dry run selected the WCS control suite and the xtask unit tests.
- The WCS control suite built. All 4 tests passed.
- The xtask suite ran: 149 tests passed and 1 failed.
- Clippy passed for xtask and camcraft-app, with all targets and warnings denied.

Requested before merge:
1. `crates/app/tests/wcs_rotation_control.rs:7`: Combine this map with the map now present on upstream/main. Keep the upstream entries and add `app::stock_sim` to that single map. PR #2365 added the first map before the provenance line. The trial merge keeps both maps. `xtask/src/scan.rs:138` reads only the first map and stops at the blank documentation line. It therefore ignores this PR's map. The new test fails for `crates/app/src/stock_sim.rs`. This PR would make the xtask suite fail on main. Run the selection test and the full xtask suite after the update.

Failure:
```text
---- gate_maps_tests::wcs_rotation_control_is_selected_for_its_app_entry_points stdout ----
selection crates/app/src/commands/mod.rs -> app: 216 suite(s)
selection crates/app/src/operation/mod.rs -> app: 236 suite(s)
selection crates/app/src/posting.rs -> app: 209 suite(s)
selection crates/app/src/stock_sim.rs -> app: 56 suite(s)
thread panicked at xtask/src/gate_maps_tests.rs:44:9:
crates/app/src/stock_sim.rs: WCS suite missing from [...]
test result: FAILED. 149 passed; 1 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 0 filtered out
```
The suite list in the error is shortened above.

The PR changes no posted G-code, geometry, collision checks, gouge checks, stock simulation logic, UI, or goldens. Safety-tier mutation checks do not apply. I made no code changes.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: Combined the two WCS gate maps into one map. Kept every upstream entry and added `app::stock_sim`.

The extended test `gate_maps_tests::wcs_rotation_control_is_selected_for_its_app_entry_points` checks the combined map and all four app entry points. It also checks that all upstream entries remain.

Mutation check: restoring the two-map header made the test fail. Restoring the fix made it pass.

Merged `upstream/main` without conflicts. The full xtask suite passed: 150 unit tests and 6 integration tests. `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed. All 4 WCS control tests passed. Clippy passed for xtask and camcraft-app with all targets and warnings denied.

New head: `31b8554c93212244e434d73c8f862da73e7c5e07`.

Please review this head again.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 31b8554c93212244e434d73c8f862da73e7c5e07 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The earlier finding is resolved. The WCS suite has one combined Gate map. It keeps all upstream entries and adds `app::stock_sim`. The new test checks these entries and suite selection for all four app entry points.

I checked the PR against current upstream AGENTS.md. The decision record and `Process change: yes` line are present. The PR does not change PROCESS_VERSION.

Local results against upstream/main at a8bb30f0c14304708766f6ed7d437bf3fdce6cc0:
- The trial merge had no conflicts. The PR already contains this main commit.
- The WCS control test target built with `--no-run`.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run` selected the WCS suite and xtask tests.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed. All 4 WCS tests, 150 xtask unit tests, and 6 xtask integration tests passed.
- The new selection test and the missing-map law passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p xtask -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

Requested before merge: none.

The PR changes test metadata, a selection test, and a decision record. It changes no posted G-code, geometry, collision checks, gouge checks, stock simulation logic, UI, or goldens. Safety-tier mutation checks do not apply. I did not repeat the author's mutation check. No GitHub runner was used. I made no code changes.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
